# SFX Brew

> Free procedural game sound effect generator. Eastern (wuxia/xianxia) and general game sounds, synthesized with Web Audio in the browser or locally in Node. Output is WAV or a dependency-free JavaScript snippet. Generated sounds are free for commercial use, no attribution required. No sign-up, no API key.

## Use it from an AI coding agent

- MCP server (local, stdio, no network): `npx -y -p sfxbrew sfxbrew-mcp`
  - Claude Code: `claude mcp add sfxbrew -- npx -y -p sfxbrew sfxbrew-mcp`
  - Tools: `list_presets`, `generate_sfx` (writes WAV files, returns seeds and patch JSON), `render_patch` (custom patch to WAV), `get_js_code` (one JS snippet with playX() functions)
- CLI: `npx sfxbrew <preset> --out assets/sfx/name.wav [--count n] [--seed n] [--js src/sfx.js]`; `npx sfxbrew list`
- Agent skill (SKILL.md): https://github.com/2365836149-sketch/sfxbrew/tree/main/skills/sfxbrew , also on Agensi: https://www.agensi.io/skills/sfx-brew-game-sound-effects

## Presets

Eastern: swordQi, guqin, bell, gong, spell, thunder, lightning, breakthrough, talisman, alchemy, chime, flute, qiGather, pipa, erhu, woodfish, drum
General: coin, pickup, click, confirm, error, jump, hit, explosion, laser, powerUp, levelUp, whoosh

Each call gives a new variation. Pass the returned seed to reproduce a sound exactly.

## Sound library pages

- https://sfxbrew.com/sounds/ — all categories; each category page (e.g. /sounds/coin-sound-effect/) has 12 fixed variations to play, download as WAV, zip, or copy as JavaScript
- Packs: https://sfxbrew.com/packs/xianxia-game-sound-pack/ and https://sfxbrew.com/packs/game-ui-sound-pack/

## Web editor links

The editor URL fragment holds the sound: `/#<presetId>.<base64url(JSON patch)>`. Opening it loads that exact sound with sliders for fine-tuning. `/#<presetId>` alone opens a fresh random sound from that preset.

## Patch format

`{ layers: [...], reverb 0-1, echo 0-0.9, echoTime s, drive 0-1, crush 0|1-16 bits, gain 0-1 }`. Layer: `type` tone|fm|string|pluck|bell|noise (string = Karplus-Strong plucked string with `bright` 0-1; bell takes optional `partials` [[ratio, amp, decayMul]]), `wave`, `freq`→`freqEnd` Hz over `slideTime` s, `start`, `attack`, `decay` s, `vol`, `filter` none|lowpass|highpass|bandpass with `cutoff`→`cutoffEnd` over `sweepTime`, `q`, `vib` cents, `vibRate`, `rep`/`repGap`/`repStep`/`scale` penta|chromatic, `unison`/`detune`, `fmRatio`/`fmIndex`/`fmDecay`.
